pre_score_amendments.change: disable Pareto pruning in the primary beam
pre_score_amendments.reason: a CPU-only synthetic integration test showed that current-score/cost dominance can remove a parent that later participates in the best conditional interaction, defeating the purpose of width-4 search

pre_score_amendments.change: bind a disjoint 512-image VQAv2-train control manifest and fully specify the MABA-style modality balance
pre_score_amendments.reason: the pre-score integration audit found that the control data identity and image/text weighting were described but not hash-bound or numerically fixed

status_note: All methodological choices below are frozen before upgraded projection scores or decoded results. Calibration, profiling, candidate-bank, and code hashes must be bound in a derived launch protocol before GPU profiling begins.

objective.primary: maximize training-only eight-cell macro mean decoded GIoU at no more than 4.5 logical decoder weight bits
objective.success_target: recover at least 75% of the uniform-W4 loss on the existing development comparison
objective.stretch_target: recover at least 90% of the uniform-W4 loss
constraints: VQAv2 must be no more than 1.5 points below uniform W4
POPE must be no more than 1.5 points below uniform W4
no confirmation result may affect allocation or checkpoint choice

quantization.scheme: symmetric signed absmax, qmax=2^(bits-1)-1, no zero point
quantization.prefix_policy: all earlier decoder layers installed from their cached W4 candidates
quantization.candidate_pair_rule: W4 and W8 for one projection use identical pristine BF16 weight and independent clones of one immutable Hessian

artifact_accounting.primary: actual serialized packed code and scale payload bytes

profiling_data.category_rule: one non-crowd instance of the requested category in the complete image annotation, including crowd annotations in the ambiguity check
profiling_data.selection_order: SHA-256 rank with fixed seed; independent of upstream iteration order
forbidden_sources: all RefCOCO/RefCOCO+/RefCOCOg non-training images across variants

proxy.candidate: replace exactly one projection with its cached matched GPTQ-W8 tensor
proxy.positions: tokens overlapping only the four numeric bbox_2d coordinate spans
aggregation: mean four coordinates within each row
mean rows within each task x relative-area-quartile cell
macro mean over all eight cells
proxy.shortlist_rule: positive macro KL repair per exact added byte, descending

decoded_rerank.candidates: decode every one of the frozen 24 singleton promotions
decoded_rerank.primary_metric: paired mean-GIoU change, macro averaged over eight cells

allocation.candidate_membership: exactly the frozen top-24 proxy shortlist
allocation.objective: eight-cell macro mean decoded GIoU on the training-only decode manifest
allocation.secondary_policy: derive from the same frozen trace without retuning or another search
allocation.marginal_rule: strictly greater than zero relative to each parent state
allocation.state_cost: sum of exact cached W8-minus-W4 packed payload bytes
allocation.pareto_prune_rationale: a currently lower-scoring or costlier parent may have the strongest future conditional interaction; pruning it would silently collapse beam diversity
allocation.stop: no feasible strictly positive conditional marginal remains
allocation.evaluation_cache_key: SHA-256 of sorted exact module names plus candidate-bank and decode-manifest hashes

matched_controls.target_bytes: exact added bytes used by the final primary GCQ allocation
matched_controls.uniform_w4: zero-promotion common anchor; report its smaller actual payload
matched_controls.projection_additive_gcq: exact-cost 0/1 knapsack over isolated numeric-coordinate proxy repairs
matched_controls.original_coarse_gcq: historical attention/MLP groups materialized from the new bank and reported at their historical actual bytes

vqa_driven.allocation: exact-cost 0/1 knapsack over training-only answer-token KL repair
vqa_driven.source: official VQAv2 train questions and annotations
vqa_driven.example_selection: one SHA-256-ranked question per eligible image followed by SHA-256-ranked unique images
vqa_driven.exclusions: all images used by earlier recovery training/development, the two GCQ profile manifests, D_probe, and all confirmation manifests
vqa_driven.score: mean W4 minus singleton-W8 full-vocabulary BF16-teacher KL at causal logits predicting official answer tokens

random.rule: uniform draws from exact-cost feasible projection subsets via dynamic-programming counts; report every seed and their mean; never select the best seed

maba_style.label: additive MABA-style reimplementation, not the authors' implementation
maba_style.activation_stream: all-W4 student on the frozen VQAv2-train control manifest
maba_style.local_score: W4-to-W8 reduction in projection-output squared reconstruction error relative to BF16 projection-output energy

selection_and_confirmation.development_success_check: existing exposed RefCOCO development comparison, once after allocation freeze
selection_and_confirmation.failure_policy: retain and report the frozen result; do not use confirmation outcomes to try another allocation
